shorts_extract.hook: Why feeling guilty about missing 10,000 steps is backwards—new Harvard PET brain scans show just 5,000 to 7,500 daily steps delay Alzheimer's memory decline by ~7 years.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Harvard Aging Brain Study (2019 JAMA Neurology N=182; 2025 Nature Medicine N=296) + UK Biobank 78,430-adult accelerometer study.
shorts_extract.twist: Walking didn't erase amyloid plaques—it slammed the brakes on downstream tau tangles that actually destroy memory cells, plateauing right around 7,500 steps.
